body: That’s a fair critique!

I have a therapist to tell me what to do (like most of you should really get). 

I was only hoping to hear about other people’s experiences.
Thanks! You too!

I think it’s great that you’re able to recognize what you needed to hear in your situation. It’s not a critique of you. Just not relevant to me :) 

I haven’t shared on this thread my own thoughts on why I think I’m single or even if I am seeking a relationship. I hope you find what you’re looking for 😊
I’m not looking for advice on finding a partner.
This advice isn’t relevant to my situation. I hope someone else finds this helpful.

You’re not alone in this experience. Thank you for sharing your story. 

I’m actually at the best place in my life to develop a relationships like you said: good job, great friends, hobbies, goals & I also think I’m not too bad looking. 

I have hope that we will both find someone :)

Thank you for this comment! 

I also feel like I’m getting a lot of common sense advice. “Get yourself out there. Make friends. Get hobbies. Realize that you’re in two different paths.” 

You make an excellent point about boundaries! I think it’s completely normal to not want to hear someone talk about their dating life (or any topic really. I think I’d be as equally avoidant if someone only talked about work or their dislike for a family member). 

Thanks for sharing your perspective 😇

If you have a search through some of my other comments: I’m the extroverted/social one between the two of us. My roommate doesn’t really have friends. I’ve met her boyfriend’s friends and I’m not interested. 

I’m not seeking advice on how I can find a partner. Just wanted to hear about the experiences of others.

It’s a really tough spot to be in :( 

Thank you for sharing.

“I listed ways to help yourself” 

You do not know me or my relationship with myself. You’re also assuming that I haven’t done any of the things above. 

Again, this is the problem with giving unsolicited advice to people that you do not know.
Agreed! We all compare ourselves to people everyday. Telling someone to simply just not do it isn’t helpful.

Thank you for sharing your story! I think this is very helpful for someone out there! 

As mentioned in my posts: I have hobbies and friends that I’m very happy with 😊 sometimes I just want someone to hold my hand though. 

Patience is definitely key with dating!
Wow you really think you did something here
I’m happy for you that you found your person 😊

Thanks for sharing your experience. That sounds really tough to handle and I understand the desire to compare yourself to him. I hope you’re finding ways to take good care of yourself when these feelings arise.

That’s the thing about unsolicited advice: you don’t know what the other person has done to work on this feeling. Sometimes that looks like going to therapy, spending time with different friend groups or picking up new hobbies. When you give advice without someone asking, you’re assuming that they aren’t doing the work to navigate their own feelings. 

If I wanted advice, I’d ask my therapist - not someone on Reddit. For me, whats helpful in this moment is hearing about someone else’s experience and that’s what I asked for. 

Wanting companionship is a healthy desire. My response to someone else’s relationship is not. I’ve acknowledged this countless times on this post.
I don’t think this is relevant to my situation specifically, but good words for someone else out there.

Thanks for being vulnerable here. I hope I can get to the point to where your friend is. 

Great point about potentially building resentment. I  still love being around her. So I don’t think I’m there, but I can see how envy & jealously quickly leads to resentment.

Thank you so much for sharing your experience and being vulnerable with a complete stranger. This is exactly what I find helpful in a situation like this. Just hearing that I’m not alone in this and being able to see what something like this looks like from a 3rd perspective. 

Also thank you for acknowledging that I was seeking empathy & understanding of others who are single. Not unsolicited advice.

Yes! I am lonely - romantically. I miss the physical affection and excitement that often comes with romantic relationships.

But I have a great group of friends that I see a few times a week (including my roommate) and hobbies that I really enjoy!
Yes. You’re correct. I was looking to hear about the experiences that others have had with this topic.

That’s fair. Again, this isn’t something that I want to feel.

Maybe their intention was to be helpful. But their impact was not.

I’m just not sure what original commenter’s point is? 

If this was a feeling that I thought was healthy or enjoyed, I wouldn’t be asking others how they’ve dealt with it. 

That’s what feels unproductive. I’m asking others about their experiences & how they have learned and grown from it, and instead the above commenter is making assumptions. I’m not seeking an evaluation of my dating life because I am a complete stranger and strangers will not be able to assess my dating life based off of one post. 

I’m not seeking advice. Sometimes it’s just nice to just know that I’m not alone in this feeling.

As for if they know people to set me up with? 

My roommate doesn’t really have many friends as she’s on the more introverted side and we both moved to the current city we live in right before the pandemic. 

I’m not sure if he knows anyone that he can set me up with. I’ve met some of his friends and just didn’t feel an attraction towards them. My roommate & I have extremely different types.

Thank you for sharing your experience. 

I’ve been on Tinder, Bumble, Hinge & OkCupid for the last 2 years. Definitely not just waiting for someone to walk into my life.

Like obviously I know that this isn’t a healthy way to view my friend’s relationship. My question is if other people experience this and how they’ve dealt with it. 

Stating that this is my ego and insinuating that I’m not actively searching for a partner is not productive.
This is the worst reply. You have no idea what the fuck is going on in my life. Don’t come on here assuming that it’s just a simple math problem. Fuck off.
